SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount) AS revenue_change
FROM lineitem
WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
  AND l_discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.07
  AND l_quantity < 24

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_orders
FROM customer c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
WHERE o.o_orderkey IS NULL

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS order_year,
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS urgent_pct
FROM orders
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate)
ORDER BY order_year

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS inventory_value FROM partsupp ps INNER JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY inventory_value DESC LIMIT 3

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    c_mktsegment AS market_segment,
    c_name AS customer_name,
    c_acctbal AS account_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY c_acctbal DESC, c_custkey) AS rn
  FROM customer
)
SELECT market_segment, customer_name, account_balance
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY market_segment, account_balance DESC, customer_name

WITH basket AS (
  SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count
  FROM lineitem
  GROUP BY l_orderkey
)
SELECT o.o_orderstatus AS order_status,
       AVG(b.line_count) AS avg_line_items_per_order
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN basket b ON o.o_orderkey = b.l_orderkey
GROUP BY o.o_orderstatus
ORDER BY o.o_orderstatus

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS order_year,
         SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
  FROM lineitem l
  INNER JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT order_year,
       revenue,
       (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year)) * 100.0
         / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year) AS pct_change
FROM yearly
ORDER BY order_year
